Sources: software/rust/firmware/src (pins, TBR); hardware/obc/OBC_DESIGN.md, STORAGE_DESIGN.md; STM32L4R5 datasheet (supply, LSE). * = proposed here, not in firmware
C1-C9 100 nF, one at each VDD pin; C10 4.7 uF bulk; VDDIO2 and VDDUSB each 100 nF (TBR).
VBAT tied to 3V3_AO: no backup cell, the RTC runs from the always-on rail (TBR).
J1 pins 9-10 are jumpered in the GSE plug:
100 nF at VDD; 10k pull-up on CS# (TBR)
0x48 is also the EPS controller's address in the
Pull-ups to 3V3_AO (TBR). ANTENNA/SOLAR_SENSE also get the RC filter of S5.
